slides.title: What Happened Monday, Nov 16
slides.body: The Nasdaq fell 2.5% and the Dow fell 739 points, or 1.4%. Tech led the decline, and the major indexes ended near their lows of the day.

slides.title: Monday's Declines
slides.subtitle: Percent drop at the Nov 16 close
slides.body: Nvidia fell for a third straight day after its CEO resigned. It reports results Tuesday after the close.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Reports cite Nvidia's leadership change, new US limits on China's access to advanced AI chips, a 10-year yield above 5.1%, and an expected Fed rate hike in December.
